research_question: Which culturally situated expressions and entities occur in multilingual sources, and how do their local contexts describe them?
inclusion_criteria: Collect culturally meaningful vocabulary, practices, foods, celebrations, and named entities when their association is supported by context.
Retain original scripts, spelling, code-switching, transliterations, and distinct community senses; describe cultural association as a suggestion requiring human review.
Include established expressions and named entities. Cultural relevance does not require novelty or a minimum frequency.
Keep original context separate from any generated translation and keep human annotations separate from model suggestions.
exclusion_criteria: Exclude generic everyday expressions when the source supplies no culturally situated use.
Do not infer a person's identity, belief, or culture solely from their name or the language of a document.
Do not replace original text with a translation or claim that a model-proposed cultural association is source-confirmed.

positive.text: 春节是这段家庭记录中庆祝农历新年的节日。
positive.sense: a celebration of the lunar new year in this family account
positive.reason: Original-script cultural entity explicitly described in context.

positive.text: In this family account, お花見 names a gathering to view cherry blossoms.
positive.sense: a gathering to view cherry blossoms
positive.reason: Established cultural practice is included without a novelty requirement.

negative.reason: A name alone does not establish cultural identity or association.

boundary.text: At the local café, volunteers organize a fictional neighborhood poetry gathering.
boundary.reason: A borrowed word is not automatically culturally diagnostic; retain only a project-relevant contextual association.

boundary.text: The source uses a transliteration alongside the original name.
boundary.reason: Aliases may be linked reversibly; a transliteration must not silently replace original-script evidence.

cultural_association.description: Model suggestion of locally supported association; not a demographic inference.

entity_type.description: Model suggestion: practice, celebration, food, place, person, artifact, or other.

transliteration.description: Optional generated transliteration; never original evidence.

specialist_lenses.lens: Attend to original-script cultural entities, transliterations, and code-switched vocabulary while retaining all qualifying terms.
Attend to culturally situated senses and practices whose names look familiar while retaining all qualifying terms.
